Timeline event 133: ## What the E14 vectors MEAN (see docs/E14_SEMANTIC_ROLE.md) Timeline event 134: BGE-M3 Dense is XLM-RoBERTa-Large CLS-pooled → 1024-D L2-normalised. Its training data covers 194 languages across MIRACL, Mr. TyDi, and a large unsupervised multilingual corpus. The resulting vectors encode **cross-lingual, cross-register, long-context meaning**: Timeline event 135: - Translation pairs (e.g. English / Japanese) cluster with cosine ≥ 0.8 under E14; under E1 (e5-large-v2, English-centric) they'd be far apart. - 8192-token context means E14 sees full documents where every other dense embedder truncates at 512. Queries buried deep in long docs only surface when E14 participates. - Register-neutral semantics: formal/informal paraphrases of the same idea are penalised less by E14 than by style-sensitive models. - Harder to fool by lexical overlap: \"dog bites man\" vs \"man bites dog\" have low E14 cosine despite keyword overlap.
